name: Hazard Protocol
description: Industrial and utilitarian: matte black mask, white silkscreen, ENIG. Groups sit in 45 degree chamfered frames titled with knockout tags; one hatch pattern marks declared no-go zones and nothing else; designators are sparse, shown where a person at the bench needs them; the board name and revision sit on a bottom nameplate with no date; an edge text ring is an option for round boards. Marks are placeholders until the owner registers their own.

notes.designator.targetShare: About a third of the parts labeled on the reference board, bench classes first.
notes.frame.style: Chamfered frames replaced square group boxes on the reference board.
notes.hazard.stripe: One pattern everywhere: 0.45 mm stripes, 0.45 mm gaps, 45 degrees, no outline.
notes.nameplate.date: Ruling: where the written rules disagree, the final reference board wins: no date.
notes.placement.grid: Parts are aligned to frames before routing only when the user asks.
notes.type.font: Stroke text on silkscreen for now (ruling).
